messages:
Alex Chen: Heads up — Hosted API: Unified Toolchain v3 (adaptive tool-calling + webhook outputs) is GA as of today. Rolling to 100% over the next 48h. Docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/toolchain-v3 :tada:

Deploy Bot: deploy: toolchain-v3 -> prod started by @alex. Canaries: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h. See deploy details in #eng-releases.

Jordan Li: Awesome. Any breaking changes?

Alex Chen: Minor. Toolcall schema v3 adds `response_metadata` and changes the default webhook handshake to HMAC SHA256. SDKs will bump minor versions. Migration notes: https://redwood.ai/docs/migrate-toolcall-v2-to-v3

Lina Gomez: @Alex can you paste the webhook signature header format?

Alex Chen: Sure:

x-rw-signature: sha256=base64(hmac_sha256(secret, body))

Example curl:
```
curl -X POST https://myapp/hooks -H 'x-rw-signature: sha256=...' -d '{"event":"tool_response"}'
```

Mari Patel: What about rate limits and quotas — will existing customers see changes?

Alex Chen: No change to per-api-key default rate limits. We added an opt-in priority tier (adaptive_latency=true) for enterprise which may route to low-latency pool; if you have dedicated capacity consult your Redwood rep before enabling.

Jordan Li: SDK bump details?

Alex Chen: JS: @redwood/sdk v1.8.0 adds toolcall.v3 helpers. Python: redwood==1.15.0. Backwards-compatible helpers included.

Ops Bot: Alert: rollout-error-rate threshold set to 1% for toolcall-v3. Notifications to #eng-oncall.

Lina Gomez: Thx. I'll add webhook verification test to our e2e suite.

Alex Chen: Please test in staging using the canary keys (info in the doc). If you see anything weird ping #eng-runtime and @Jordan Li. We'll host a quick walkthrough tomorrow 10:30am PT (calendar invite sent).

Jordan Li: Note for Private/Dedicated customers — Console > Services > Tooling has an admin toggle to enable webhook outputs. Private deployments require an operator upgrade to v3; see private-deploy notes in the doc.

Mari Patel: Will the old endpoint (toolcall/v2) be deprecated?

Alex Chen: We'll keep v2 for at least 9 months. Deprecation notice will be sent 60 days prior to removal. No forced migration for now.

All: :rocket:
